acceptance_gate: positive development-OOS net return and Sharpe
development-OOS net return at least B1
maximum drawdown no worse than B1
total absolute turnover no greater than B1
edge per turnover at least B1
at least 7 of 12 profitable OOS folds
at least 3 profitable OOS calendar years
paired 95% lower bound above zero for annualised mean-return delta versus B1
paired 95% lower bound above zero for Sharpe delta versus B1
source, chronology, next-open timing and exact fee identities pass

comparators.b1: daily 00:00 UTC 2160H endpoint-trend long/cash, next-open execution

hypothesis: Sustained own-instrument intrabar closes near the upper part of the hourly range confirm durable positive 2160H trends. A robust 720H close-location pressure entry filter should skip weak positive-trend regimes, preserve B1 continuation gains, reduce turnover and drawdown, and improve bilateral net Sharpe and edge per turnover.

rule.entry: when cash, base state positive and pressure_t exceeds instrument-local training q60 conditional on positive base state
rule.exit: when long, exit only when the daily 2160H base state becomes non-positive
rule.hourly_close_location: (2*close-high-low)/(high-low), with zero if high equals low
rule.pressure: median of 30 non-overlapping 24H block medians over trailing 720H

uncertainty.method: paired non-circular moving-block bootstrap of observed real candidate and B1 returns
